Bhide's uncle (Bhau Kaka) arrives directly from Ratnagiri to confront Jethalal over insulting Bhide regarding spoiled mangoes. After Jethalal explains his frustration and apologizes, Bhau Kaka takes full responsibility as a true trader and delivers fresh replacement crates for everyone.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
